Care that feels good

Forget what you think you know about going to the dentist. No lectures. No pressure. No feeling like just another number.

At My Dear Dentist, we do things differently. Whether you’re here for a routine cleaning or a full smile transformation, we make every visit warm, comfortable, and centered around you. Because great Montrose dental services aren’t just about your teeth, they’re about helping you feel truly cared for, inside and out.

New to My Dear Dentist?
We have a little something just for you

Take advantage of our $99 new patient special, designed to help you start your smile journey with ease. Your visit includes a comprehensive exam, routine cleaning, and our curated new patient welcome package — thoughtfully designed to support your whole-body health at home.

It’s our way of saying: Welcome. We’re so glad you’re here.

modules.html:
General Dentistry

Preventive and restorative care for every stage of life, from routine cleanings and exams to fillings, crowns, and more. We help you maintain a healthy and strong smile.

Sleep Dentistry

Our Montrose dentists provide comfortable, custom oral appliances to help treat sleep apnea and snoring, so you can breathe easier, sleep better, and improve your overall health and energy.

modules.alt: Sleep Dentistry at My Dear Dentistry
smiling patient seated in dentist chair at My Dear Dentist office for a cosmetic procedure

modules.html:
Cosmetic Dentistry

Boost your confidence with a brighter, more beautiful smile. We offer whitening, veneers, Invisalign, and more, customized to your goals and designed to look naturally stunning.

Restorative Dentistry

Rebuild your smile with expert care. Whether you need a single tooth repaired or full-mouth reconstruction, we offer advanced solutions, including dental implants, to restore function, comfort, and confidence.

modules.alt: Sleep Dentistry at My Dear Dentistry
smiling patient seated in dentist chair at My Dear Dentist office for a cosmetic procedure

modules.html:
Biological Dentistry

Support your smile and your overall wellness with dentistry designed to work in harmony with your whole body. Our biological approach uses biocompatible materials, minimally invasive techniques, and personalized care to help protect your oral health naturally.
